other_conditions: Must be enrolled in a Government College and pursuing general courses
Candidates from non‑government colleges or correspondence/open university courses are not eligible
Must be one of the top three students (first, second, or third) in the annual university examination for the respective stream
Merit list is prepared separately for boys (General Category), girls (General Category) and Scheduled Caste students; SC students can also appear in the general list
benefits_summary: Monetary incentive of ₹5,000 for first position, ₹3,000 for second, and ₹2,000 for third per annum, disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
